heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 Mini handles Elegoo Rapid PETG right out of the box without an enclosure, delivering reliable prints at speeds up to 238 mm/s based on a 20 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. Its direct drive extruder and 300°C-capable hotend easily melt and control this high-flow filament on the stock stainless steel nozzle.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with liquid glue or glue stick as a release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 20 mm³/s in the filament settings to exploit Elegoo Rapid PETG high-melt characteristics safely.
Enable 'Wipe while retracting' (2 mm distance) and 'Retract on layer change' to eliminate fine stringing inherent to low-viscosity PETG.
Configure Part Cooling Fan to 30% min and 60% max with a 12-second layer threshold to balance rapid cooling against strong layer adhesion.
Adjust Pressure Advance (Linear Advance) factor to roughly 0.038–0.042 s to maintain crisp corner geometry at 238 mm/s speeds.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Severe PETG adhesion bonding leading to PEI coating tear-out
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG creates an overly aggressive chemical bond directly onto smooth or warm PEI sheets upon cooling.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a thin, uniform layer of glue stick or Bambu liquid glue to act as an interfacial release barrier, and allow the bed to cool below 35°C before removing parts.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine wispy stringing and nozzle accumulation during rapid travels
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Ambient moisture absorbed by the hygroscopic filament combined with excessive travel nozzle oozing.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the filament spool at 65°C for 6 hours; set Z-hop type to 'Auto' or 'Normal' (0.2 mm) and enable travel moves to avoid crossing perimeters.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Matte finish or layer splitting on thin vertical walls
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Part cooling fan running at excessive speeds (above 70%), freezing the rapid PETG melt pool before molecular fusion occurs.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Cap the maximum fan cooling threshold at 60% and ensure the printing nozzle temperature is maintained at 243°C.

faq.question: Can the A1 Mini reach the full 238 mm/s print speed without hotend upgrades?
faq.answer: Yes, with Elegoo Rapid PETG's high melt flow formulation and the stock 0.4mm nozzle running at 243°C, the A1 Mini reliably sustains the 20 mm³/s volumetric limit which yields 238 mm/s at 0.2mm layer height.

faq.question: Does printing Elegoo Rapid PETG require an enclosure on the A1 Mini?
faq.answer: No, PETG does not suffer from extreme thermal contraction like ABS or ASA, so it prints reliably in open-air ambient environments without an enclosure.

faq.question: Is the stock stainless steel nozzle durable enough for Elegoo Rapid PETG?
faq.answer: Yes, standard Elegoo Rapid PETG is non-abrasive and completely safe to run continuously through the stock stainless steel nozzle without premature bore wear.

faq.question: Why is glue stick recommended if the A1 Mini comes with a textured PEI plate?
faq.answer: PETG adheres exceptionally well to PEI; using a thin layer of glue acts as a release barrier rather than an adhesive, preventing damage to the textured PEI coating during part removal.
